record.body:
## Description

R1: The UI lives in `dashboard/frontend`, and `dashboard/web` does not exist.
R2: The server serves `dashboard/frontend/dist`.
R12: Every existing deep link still resolves to the same screen (the `deepLinks` and `links` Vitest files stay unchanged).
Context: the web UI (Vite + Svelte 5 + TypeScript + Tailwind 4, Biome lint, Vitest) lives at `dashboard/web/ui` with a 1,264-line `src/App.svelte` (613 lines of script). The FastAPI server lives in `dashboard/backend/server/` and serves `dashboard/web/ui/dist`. This phase moves the UI to `dashboard/frontend`, adds the `$lib` alias and shadcn-svelte, splits `App.svelte` into state modules and screens, and adopts the shadcn default look. Behavior, routes, and deep links do not change. The lint gate stays at zero findings. The CI `web` job runs `npm ci`, `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test`, `npm run build` in the UI folder. `npm run check` also runs `api-types:check`.

## Approach

`git mv dashboard/web/ui dashboard/frontend` (keep `node_modules` and `dist` untracked: move them with `mv` or reinstall). Remove the empty `dashboard/web` folder. Update every reference: `DIST` in `dashboard/backend/server/app.py`, `dashboard/bin/web`, `scripts/api_schema.py` default paths, the `web` job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`working-directory`, `cache-dependency-path`), `.gitignore`, `biome.json`, `package.json` scripts and paths, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, the UI `README.md`, skills and docs that name `dashboard/web/ui`, and the tests that name it (`tests/test_ci_workflow.py`, `tests/test_web_gate.py`, `tests/dashboard/*`). Update the pinned path strings in the older frozen oracle tests (`tests/test_ci_workflow.py`, `tests/test_web_gate.py`, `tests/dashboard/test_data_layer.py`, `tests/dashboard/test_api_schema.py`, `tests/test_remove_textual.py`) only where they hard-code `dashboard/web/ui`; change nothing else in them. Do not edit `tests/dashboard/test_ui_structure.py`. The `deepLinks.test.ts` and `links.test.ts` files must keep their bytes. Run `cd dashboard/frontend && npm ci && npm run lint && npm run check && npm test && npm run build`, then `uv run pytest tests/dashboard tests/test_ci_workflow.py tests/test_web_gate.py tests/test_remove_textual.py -q -n 4`.
